notes:
Tidier screens, and writing that keeps its thickness between tablets.

The "Reader" button now disappears on the library, organ and settings screens when nothing is open, instead of sitting there doing nothing.

Writing done on one tablet used to arrive noticeably thinner on another, because a pen width was stored as a number of screen dots rather than as a size on the page — and the two tablets do not have the same number of dots across a page. Obbligato now records pen and highlighter width the same way it already records where a stroke sits: relative to the page. Writing made from now on keeps its thickness wherever you open it, and stays in proportion on a cropped page too.

Writing you have already done is untouched and looks exactly as it did.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
